limitations: The resident handoff is supplied; this is not a cold ROM/resident boot.
Unknown MMIO remains a recorded frontier, even when the mapped backing memory permits execution.
Instruction counts and read-driven GPT are functional-model work, not measured hardware timing.
This check does not establish sampler/audio/storage operation or complete stock startup.
poisonPattern: A5 throughout each declared zero destination, checked before execution
diagnostic: Explicit host translation-cache flush after verified real scatter; firmware bytes unchanged

frontier.observedFailure: RuntimeError: memory access out of bounds
frontier.classification: WASM execution failure; cause unresolved, not a demonstrated peripheral failure
frontier.preservation: stock-startup-first-trace-failure.json retains the first instrumented failure and its register snapshot

cleanup: Engine is not reused or closed after its WASM fault; process teardown releases it.
